name: Akkad
startIntroPart1: For generations, the peoples of Mesopotamia honor your name for uniting all of Mesopotamia, becoming the First Empire. May you unite the world under your banner, under the nation of Akkad!
attacked: You want to conquer my nation? My people shall great you with open, armed arms!
defeated: I have built an empire as tall as the greatest trees, and now it comes crashing down like one. May yours suffer the same fate..
introduction: I am Sargon the Great of Akkad. And who must you be?
hateLetsHearIt: What do you want this time?
afterPeace: Very well. Our War shall end this day. For however long..
tradeRequest: I would like to offer youe trade agreement.
